name: examguard
description: A consent-first browser exam-integrity prototype for classroom research.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @examguard/api && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test packages/contracts/src/common.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts packages/contracts/src/auth.test.ts packages/contracts/src/exam.test.ts apps/api/src apps/web/src apps/desktop/src scripts/lan-config.test.ts scripts/demo-lib.test.ts scripts/phone-lab-lib.test.ts supabase/functions
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @examguard/api && npm run build --workspace @examguard/web
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.package:mac: npm run vision:prepare && npm run build:whisper-portable && npm run build --workspace @examguard/web && npm run build:bundle --workspace @examguard/api && npm run build --workspace @examguard/desktop && npm run pack:judge --workspace @examguard/desktop
